tag_line: Tag the one who measured the flat twice.

items.Yang Wood: Big plant by the door before the sofa arrives.
items.Yin Wood: Shelves on every wall. 'There's still space.'
items.Yang Fire: Warm lights everywhere. The flat glows from the corridor.
items.Yin Fire: Picked the dining lamp first. Took three weeks.
items.Yang Earth: Bed head on a solid wall. Non-negotiable.
items.Yin Earth: Kettle unpacked first. Boxes can wait.
items.Yang Metal: Knife block in the drawer. Counter stays clear.
items.Yin Metal: Mirror moved twice so it won't face the bed.
items.Yang Water: Moved the sofa four times. Still deciding.
items.Yin Water: Shoe rack at the door, sorted by colour, done.
